pages.text: Meridian Workspace is a commercial fit-out contractor based in Birmingham. We design and build office interiors, industrial and warehouse fit-out, and we handle cat A to cat B fit-out for landlords and occupiers across the Midlands. Our services: office fit-out and refurbishment; industrial and warehouse fit-out; space planning and design; mechanical and electrical installation; furniture supply and installation; post-occupancy support. We work with professional services firms, technology companies, manufacturers and logistics operators taking new space or reconfiguring existing premises. Typical projects run from 3,000 to 60,000 sq ft. We do not undertake residential work, new-build shell and core construction, or projects outside the Midlands and surrounding counties. We are not a furniture reseller and do not take on fit-outs below about 2,000 sq ft.
